name: openbb_earnings
description:
Meant to give earnings history for one stock through OpenBB (obb.equity.fundamental.earnings).
Returns: {symbol, earnings: [...]} or {symbol, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; provider (default yfinance).
OpenBB 4.x (4.6 checked) has no obb.equity.fundamental.earnings, so this tool currently returns an error object; alternatives: yf_earnings_history, yf_earnings_dates or av_earnings.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
